profiles.battery_full: Battery passport (Art. 77): EV, LMT, industrial > 2 kWh
profiles.battery_basic: Battery information via QR (Art. 13(6)): portable, SLI, industrial ≤ 2 kWh

category_rules.rule: Check in this order; the first match decides. Units that work as one integrated system with common components, such as a shared battery management system, count as one battery, so add up their capacity. Cells or modules sold ready for end use count as the kind they most resemble, and the strictest kind if several fit.

kinds.condition: A drive battery for a hybrid or electric road vehicle of category M, N or O, or a drive battery weighing over 25 kg for a vehicle of category L.

A drive battery for a wheeled vehicle moved by a motor alone or by a motor and human power together, such as pedalling or pushing, a category L vehicle included, sealed and 25 kg or less, and not an EV battery. Not a battery for a boat, which is not wheeled, or for a toy vehicle, which is portable, and not one for an industrial machine such as a pallet truck, which takes the capacity rule.

Made to power the starter, lighting or ignition system of a vehicle, boat or machine; it may also serve auxiliary or backup uses there. A camper's or boat's house battery made only for living-area power is not one, and takes the capacity rule. The 12 V battery of a hybrid or electric car is one, not a drive battery.
Sealed, 5 kg or less, not designed specifically for industrial use, and not an EV, LMT or SLI battery.
Any other battery of 2 kWh or less.
Any other battery over 2 kWh with built-in storage, made to store energy and deliver it to the grid or to users.

fields.name: due_diligence_report_url
fields.label: Information of due diligence report
fields.description: Link or upload your battery due-diligence report from your supply-chain team. These obligations start on 18 August 2027. Two exemptions apply. The first covers a net turnover below €40 million in the financial year before the last one, when you are not part of a group whose consolidated turnover exceeds €40 million. The second covers a battery prepared for re-use or repurposing, repurposed or remanufactured, that was already placed on the market or put into service before.

fields.name: battery_chemistry

fields.description: Pick the battery's chemistry from the EU list. Keep the name from your datasheet in Battery chemistry.

fields.name: critical_raw_material_codes

fields.name: cathode_anode_electrolyte_materials

fields.name: spare_parts_sources_url

fields.name: post_consumer_recycled_lithium_share

fields.name: recycled_lead_share

fields.name: end_user_waste_prevention_url

fields.name: end_user_separate_collection_url

fields.description: Link or upload instructions for handing in this battery for separate collection, using the collection scheme's information.

fields.name: collection_and_second_life_url

fields.label_ro: Instrucțiuni de siguranță pentru bateriile uzate

fields.name: rated_capacity
fields.label: Rated capacity
fields.description: Copy the rated capacity from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Listed as rated capacity or nominal capacity, in Ah (or mAh for small/LMT batteries).

fields.name: rated_capacity_unit
fields.label: Rated capacity unit
fields.description: Pick Ah, or mAh for LMT batteries — match whatever your datasheet uses.

fields.name: capacity_fade
fields.label: Capacity fade
fields.description: Copy the manufacturer's documented figure for how much capacity the battery loses over time.
fields.hint: Take it from the manufacturer's performance and durability document. If the document gives no capacity fade, ask the manufacturer for it. If it only gives the capacity kept, subtract that from 100: 80% kept means 20% fade.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(a) -> Art. 10(1) -> Annex IV Part A(1)

fields.name: minimum_voltage
fields.label: Minimum voltage
fields.description: Copy the minimum safe operating voltage from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Listed as minimum, cut-off, or discharge voltage on the datasheet.

fields.name: maximum_voltage
fields.label: Maximum voltage
fields.description: Copy the maximum safe operating voltage from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Listed as maximum or charge voltage on the datasheet.

fields.name: nominal_voltage
fields.label: Nominal voltage
fields.description: Copy the nominal voltage from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Use the nominal voltage stated for this battery model and configuration in its technical documentation.

fields.name: voltage_temperature_lower

fields.name: voltage_temperature_upper
fields.label: Voltage temperature range, upper limit
fields.description: Enter the highest temperature at which the minimum, nominal and maximum voltages apply.

fields.name: original_power_capability

fields.hint: Listed as rated or continuous power, in watts (W).

fields.name: power_fade

fields.description: Copy the manufacturer's documented figure for how much power the battery loses over time.
fields.hint: Take it from the manufacturer's performance and durability document. If the document gives no power fade, ask the manufacturer for it. If it only gives the power kept, subtract that from 100: 90% kept means 10% fade.

fields.name: maximum_permitted_battery_power

fields.name: initial_round_trip_energy_efficiency

fields.name: round_trip_energy_efficiency_at_50_of_cycle_life
fields.label: Round trip energy efficiency at 50% of cycle life
fields.label_ro: Eficiență dus-întors la 50% din durata de viață
fields.description: Copy the round-trip energy efficiency at half the battery's cycle life from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Listed as round-trip efficiency or RTE at 50% of cycle life, as a percentage.

fields.name: energy_round_trip_efficiency_fade
fields.label: Energy round trip efficiency fade

fields.name: initial_self_discharge_rate

fields.hint: Listed as self-discharge rate, usually as a percentage per month.

fields.name: initial_self_discharge_rate_per_year
fields.label: Initial self-discharge rate per year
fields.description: Copy the yearly self-discharge rate at the start of life from the technical documentation for this battery model, if given.
fields.hint: Use the yearly figure only. Leave this blank if the datasheet gives a monthly rate.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Art. 14 -> Annex VII Part A(4)

fields.name: initial_internal_resistance_pack
fields.label: Initial internal resistance of the battery pack
fields.description: Use the manufacturer's documented resistance measurement for the assembled battery pack.
fields.hint: Look for DC-IR, DCIR, or internal resistance, usually quoted in milliohms (mΩ).

fields.name: initial_internal_resistance_pack_unit
fields.label: Pack resistance unit
fields.description: Look for DC-IR, DCIR, or internal resistance, usually quoted in milliohms (mΩ).

fields.name: initial_internal_resistance_of_battery_cell

fields.description: Use the manufacturer's documented resistance measurement for one cell of this battery model.
fields.hint: Look for DC-IR, DCIR, or internal resistance, usually quoted in milliohms (mΩ).

fields.name: initial_internal_resistance_cell_unit
fields.label: Cell resistance unit
fields.description: Look for DC-IR, DCIR, or internal resistance, usually quoted in milliohms (mΩ).

fields.name: internal_resistance_increase

fields.description: Copy the manufacturer's documented figure for how much internal resistance rises over time.
fields.hint: Listed as internal resistance increase or DCIR growth on the datasheet.

fields.name: expected_lifetime_in_calendar_years
fields.label: Expected lifetime in calendar years
fields.description: Copy the expected lifetime in years from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: Listed as calendar life or design life on the datasheet.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(a) -> Annex IV Part A(5)

fields.name: expected_lifetime_number_of_charge_discharge_cycles
fields.label: Expected lifetime: Number of charge-discharge cycles
fields.description: Copy the rated number of charge-discharge cycles from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: From 18 February 2027 every battery must state all three of these. In Product basics, an industrial battery used only for back-up power can say so. So can an other industrial battery that is not designed to be recharged. Either answer removes these three. Use the documented cycle count, reference test and test C-rate together. Ask the manufacturer or technical team for missing evidence and keep unfinished work in draft. A datasheet that omits the test does not show that it is inapplicable.

fields.name: cycle_life_reference_test
fields.label: Cycle-life reference test
fields.label_ro: Test de referință pentru ciclul de viață
fields.description: Identify the reference test or test method used for this battery model's cycle-life figure, as recorded in its technical documentation.
fields.hint: From 18 February 2027 every battery must state all three of these. In Product basics, an industrial battery used only for back-up power can say so. So can an other industrial battery that is not designed to be recharged. Either answer removes these three. Use the documented cycle count, reference test and test C-rate together. Ask the manufacturer or technical team for missing evidence and keep unfinished work in draft. A datasheet that omits the test does not show that it is inapplicable.

fields.name: c_rate_of_relevant_cycle_life_test
fields.label: C-rate of relevant cycle-life test
fields.label_ro: C-rate al testului de ciclu de viață
fields.description: Copy the C-rate used for the cycle-life test from the technical documentation for this battery model.
fields.hint: From 18 February 2027 every battery must state all three of these. In Product basics, an industrial battery used only for back-up power can say so. So can an other industrial battery that is not designed to be recharged. Either answer removes these three. Use the documented cycle count, reference test and test C-rate together. Ask the manufacturer or technical team for missing evidence and keep unfinished work in draft. A datasheet that omits the test does not show that it is inapplicable.

fields.name: temperature_range_idle_state_upper_boundary

fields.description: Record how much power this battery can still deliver, in watts. Power is how fast it delivers energy. Capacity is how much charge it delivers.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Annex VII Part A(2)

fields.name: remaining_round_trip_efficiency
fields.label: Remaining round-trip efficiency
fields.description: Record the share of the energy used to charge this battery that it still gives back when it discharges, as a percentage.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Annex VII Part A(3)

fields.name: self_discharge_rate
fields.label: Self-discharge rate
fields.description: Record this battery’s self-discharge rate as a percentage per month. Dated readings show how it changes over time.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Art. 14(1) -> Annex VII Part A(4)

fields.name: self_discharge_rate_per_year
fields.label: Yearly self-discharge rate
fields.description: Record the share of its charge this battery loses by itself in a year, as a percentage. For an LMT battery, the EU DPP Registry asks for this yearly figure.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Art. 14(1) -> Annex VII Part A(4)

fields.name: ohmic_resistance
fields.label: Ohmic resistance
fields.description: Record the ohmic resistance of this battery pack as it is now, in mΩ or Ω.
regulation: Annex XIII(4)(b) -> Annex VII Part A(5)

fields.name: charge_discharge_cycles
fields.label: Charge and discharge cycles
fields.description: Record the number of charge and discharge cycles completed by this battery. Once the battery is in use, its passport must hold this information and keep it up to date. This applies from 18 February 2027.

fields.name: negative_events
fields.label: Negative events
fields.description: Describe events that affected this battery, such as an accident. Once the battery is in use, its passport must hold this information and keep it up to date. This applies from 18 February 2027.

fields.name: temperature
fields.label: Temperature
fields.description: Record this battery’s temperature in degrees Celsius. Once the battery is in use, its passport must hold this information and keep it up to date. This applies from 18 February 2027.

fields.name: state_of_charge
fields.label: State of charge
fields.description: Record this battery’s state of charge as a percentage. Once the battery is in use, its passport must hold this information and keep it up to date. This applies from 18 February 2027.
